packages.title: Clinical cancer cohort (pcx)
packages.description: De-identified clinical records for 970 patients across 7 linked tables: demographics, disease events, medical therapy, radiation, surgery, survival and treatment summary.

sessions.title: Cohort tour
sessions.description: Age at diagnosis, treatment sequencing, survival by diagnosis cohort, resection extent, radiation sites and disease events.

sessions.title: Dashboard overview
sessions.description: Patients by data cohort and diagnosis cohort, and by organization.

packages.title: Survival cubes (pcx)
packages.description: Pre-aggregated event-free and overall survival counts for 970 patients with ATRT or medulloblastoma, by diagnosis, treatment protocol, molecular subtype and site.

packages.title: HuBMAP
packages.description: Donor, sample and dataset metadata from the Human BioMolecular Atlas Program portal.

packages.title: Palmer penguins
packages.description: Body measurements for 344 penguins of three species: a small, single-table dataset to try YAC on.
